scene.action: At Arlequino's request, Rena writes a fuller festival letter to Lissa and signs it herself.
content_points: Rena explains that Arlequino personally spoke with King Carrion and obtained approval for the Festival of Eurazania: Week of Strength and its tournament.
Festival starts T+160 and runs seven days; visitors attend free.

Tournament includes mass selections, difficult terrain, an adaptive stage, and a stage pitting temporary participant groups against cohesive experienced Eurazanian beast-army units with individual judging; later days are individual combat.
Same published rules apply to Eurazanians and foreigners; outsiders may inspect relevant terrain beforehand.
Arlequino promises monetary rewards for the winner and top ten, but exact amounts remain TBD; separate Crown reward remains TBD.
Winner gains the official right to challenge Carrion, and Carrion has agreed to accept; the bout is genuine, not staged and not intended as an execution.
Arlequino intends to perform the full song Герои immediately before Carrion vs winner; full exact canonical text remains song_archive/geroi.txt.
Arlequino additionally promises to write a new separate song specifically about the eventual tournament winner after the winner is known.
Lissa is asked to spread the announcement through her contacts in Blumund, especially among adventurers, traders, performers and travelers.
scene.signature: Rena signs the letter as Рена. Arlequino stated he intends to place his own signature beside hers; actual signature not yet narrated as completed.
